summary: Gilat Satellite Networks filed a Form 6-K (the foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a press release dated October 5, 2026, announcing that its Peruvian subsidiary, Gilat Peru, signed a $28 million agreement with Pronatel, Peru's national telecommunications program, to upgrade broadband connectivity in the Ica region. Construction is expected to be completed by mid-2027, followed by a seven-year operational phase. The project will serve 116 public institutions and 30 public squares. No special-situation transaction, no deal terms, and no risk-arb angle apply.
